get_sample: run an ffmpeg command and return a single generated sample file as SrcInfo
get_samples: run an ffmpeg command and return all generated sample files as a list of SrcInfo
load_ref_video: decode a video file via ffmpeg into a numpy array with a specified shape and pixel format
load_ref_image: decode an image file via ffmpeg into a numpy array with a specified shape and pixel format
SrcInfo: use the SrcInfo dataclass to hold a file path and its associated temporary directory
